If a woman herself divorces her husband, and marries another, she commits adultery.”

translations.web: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”
translations.bsb: Now I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman commits adultery.”
translations.kjv: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
translations.asv: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and he that marrieth her when she is put away committeth adultery.
